    11	/-!
    12	# Triple-overlap rings in the finite-stage Picard atlas
    13	
    14	For three charts `U`, `V`, and `W`, the literal triple intersection is presented over
    15	the left chart by
    16	
    17	`Gamma(U intersect V) tensor_[Gamma(U)] Gamma(U intersect W)`.
    18	
    19	The first half of this file proves that this tensor product is the section ring of the
    20	exact triple intersection in the separably closed Picard representer.  The second half
    21	forms the same tensor pushout from the descended restriction maps and proves that scalar
    22	extension commutes with this construction.
    23	
    24	This is the object layer for the triple pullbacks in `Scheme.GlueData`.  Constructing the
    25	cyclic `t'` maps still requires transporting the exact transition comparison through the
    26	finite-stage model equivalences and reflecting its cocycle equation; no such gluing claim
    27	is made here.
    28	-/
    29	
    30	set_option autoImplicit false
    31	
    32	universe u
    33	
    34	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace TensorProduct
    35	open scoped TensorProduct
    36	
    37	namespace AlgebraicGeometry

    39	noncomputable section

    41	/-! ## Section rings of affine opens -/
    42	
    43	/-- If two affine opens lie in an affine open, their section rings and the section ring
    44	of their intersection form a pushout. -/
    45	private theorem isPushout_affineOpenSections_inf
    46	    {X : Scheme.{u}} (W U V : X.Opens)
    47	    (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    48	    (hUW : U <= W) (hVW : V <= W) :
    49	    let T := U ⊓ V
    50	    IsPushout
    51	      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUW).op)
    52	      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op)
    53	      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show T <= U from inf_le_left)).op)
    54	      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show T <= V from inf_le_right)).op) := by
    55	  dsimp only
    56	  let T := U ⊓ V
    57	  letI : IsAffine W := hW
    58	  letI : IsAffine U := hU
    59	  letI : IsAffine V := hV
    60	  have H : IsPullback
    61	      (X.homOfLE (show T <= U from inf_le_left))
    62	      (X.homOfLE (show T <= V from inf_le_right))
    63	      (X.homOfLE hUW) (X.homOfLE hVW) :=
    64	    isPullback_opens_inf_le hUW hVW
    65	  have hi := isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen H
    66	    (show (⊤ : (V : Scheme).Opens) <=
    67	      (X.homOfLE hVW) ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (W : Scheme).Opens) by simp)
    68	    (show (⊤ : (U : Scheme).Opens) <=
    69	      (X.homOfLE hUW) ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (W : Scheme).Opens) by simp)
    70	    (show (⊤ : (T : Scheme).Opens) =
    71	      (X.homOfLE (show T <= U from inf_le_left)) ⁻¹ᵁ
    72	          (⊤ : (U : Scheme).Opens) ⊓
    73	        (X.homOfLE (show T <= V from inf_le_right)) ⁻¹ᵁ
    74	          (⊤ : (V : Scheme).Opens) by simp)
    75	    (isAffineOpen_top W) (isAffineOpen_top V) (isAffineOpen_top U)
    76	  have hgeo := (isIso_pushoutSection_iff _ _ _ _).mp hi
    77	  have hnat (A B : X.Opens) (hAB : A <= B) :
    78	      (X.homOfLE hAB).appTop ≫ A.topIso.hom =
    79	        B.topIso.hom ≫ X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hAB).op :=
    80	    X.restrictFunctorΓ.hom.naturality (homOfLE hAB).op
    81	  refine hgeo.of_iso W.topIso U.topIso V.topIso T.topIso ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    82	  · rw [show (X.homOfLE hUW).appLE ⊤ ⊤ _ =
    83	      (X.homOfLE hUW).appTop from Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _]
    84	    exact hnat U W hUW
    85	  · rw [show (X.homOfLE hVW).appLE ⊤ ⊤ _ =
    86	      (X.homOfLE hVW).appTop from Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _]
    87	    exact hnat V W hVW
    88	  · rw [show (X.homOfLE (show T <= U from inf_le_left)).appLE ⊤ ⊤ _ =
    89	      (X.homOfLE (show T <= U from inf_le_left)).appTop from
    90	        Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _]
    91	    exact hnat T U inf_le_left
    92	  · rw [show (X.homOfLE (show T <= V from inf_le_right)).appLE ⊤ ⊤ _ =
    93	      (X.homOfLE (show T <= V from inf_le_right)).appTop from
    94	        Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _]
    95	    exact hnat T V inf_le_right

   100	
   101	/-! ## The exact triple-overlap ring -/
   102	
   103	/-- The literal triple intersection, expressed as the intersection of the two overlaps
   104	which use `U` as their left chart. -/
   105	def Pic0FiniteStageTripleOpen
   106	    (U V W : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   107	    (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left.Opens :=
   108	  (U.1.1 ⊓ V.1.1) ⊓ (U.1.1 ⊓ W.1.1)
   109	
   110	/-- The literal triple intersection of three finite-stage charts is affine. -/
   111	theorem pic0FiniteStageTripleOpen_isAffine
   112	    (U V W : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   113	    IsAffineOpen (Pic0FiniteStageTripleOpen C U V W) := by
   114	  let J := (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1
   115	  letI : GrpObj J := (picRepDatumSepClosed C).grpObj
   116	  haveI : IsSeparated J.hom := isSeparated_of_grpObj J
   117	  haveI : Scheme.IsSeparated J.left := by
   118	    constructor
   119	    rw [← Limits.terminal.comp_from J.hom]
   120	    infer_instance
   121	  exact (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U V).2.inf
   122	    (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U W).2
   123	
   124	/-- The section ring of the literal triple intersection. -/
   125	def Pic0FiniteStageTripleRing
   126	    (U V W : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) : Type u :=
   127	  Γ((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left,
   128	    Pic0FiniteStageTripleOpen C U V W)

   130	instance (U V W : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   131	    CommRing (Pic0FiniteStageTripleRing C U V W) := by
   132	  dsimp [Pic0FiniteStageTripleRing]
   133	  infer_instance
   134	
   135	noncomputable instance (U V W : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   136	    Algebra k (Pic0FiniteStageTripleRing C U V W) := by
   137	  let J := (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1
   138	  letI : J.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨J.hom⟩

   140	
   141	/-- Restriction from the first pair-overlap to the triple intersection. -/

   143	    (U V W : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   144	    Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V →ₐ[k]

   158	  let J := (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1
   159	  letI : J.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨J.hom⟩
   160	  exact
   161	    { J.left.resHom
   162	        (show Pic0FiniteStageTripleOpen C U V W <= U.1.1 ⊓ W.1.1 from inf_le_right) with
   163	      commutes' := fun r => J.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k _ r }
   164	
   165	/-- The left-chart ring, its two pair-overlap rings, and the literal triple-intersection
   166	ring form a pushout square. -/
   167	theorem isPushout_pic0FiniteStageTripleRing
   168	    (U V W : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   169	    IsPushout
   170	      (CommRingCat.ofHom (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft C U V).toRingHom)
   171	      (CommRingCat.ofHom (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft C U W).toRingHom)
   172	      (CommRingCat.ofHom (pic0FiniteStageOverlapToTripleLeft C U V W).toRingHom)
   173	      (CommRingCat.ofHom (pic0FiniteStageOverlapToTripleRight C U V W).toRingHom) := by
   174	  change IsPushout

   176	      (homOfLE (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap_le_left C U V)).op)
   177	    (((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left).presheaf.map
   178	      (homOfLE (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap_le_left C U W)).op)
   179	    (((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left).presheaf.map

   180	      (homOfLE (show Pic0FiniteStageTripleOpen C U V W <= U.1.1 ⊓ V.1.1 from
   181	        inf_le_left)).op)
   182	    (((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left).presheaf.map
   183	      (homOfLE (show Pic0FiniteStageTripleOpen C U V W <= U.1.1 ⊓ W.1.1 from
   184	        inf_le_right)).op)
   185	  exact isPushout_affineOpenSections_inf
   186	    U.1.1 (U.1.1 ⊓ V.1.1) (U.1.1 ⊓ W.1.1)

   188	    (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U W).2 inf_le_left inf_le_left
   189	
   190	/-- The first pair-overlap as an algebra over the left chart. -/
   191	@[reducible]
   192	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageOverlapLeftAlgebra
   193	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   194	    Algebra (Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U) (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V) :=

   197	/-- The triple-intersection ring as an algebra over the left chart. -/

   199	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageTripleLeftAlgebra
   200	    (U V W : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :

   202	  ((pic0FiniteStageOverlapToTripleLeft C U V W).comp
   203	    (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft C U V)).toRingHom.toAlgebra

   209	triple-intersection ring. -/

     8	/-!
     9	# Naturality of affine scalar extension
    10	
    11	For an algebra map A -> B, base change carries Spec B -> Spec A to the
    12	contravariant Spec of the scalar-extended algebra map.  The tensor factors are
    13	ordered with the extension ring on the left, matching the finite-stage Picard
    14	ring comparisons.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	set_option autoImplicit false
    18	
    19	universe u
    20	
    21	open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct
    22	open scoped TensorProduct
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicGeometry

    27

    29	
    30	variable (R K A B : Type u)
    31	variable [CommRing R] [CommRing K] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    32	variable [Algebra R K] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    33	
    34	/-- The affine base-change isomorphism with the extension ring as the left
    35	tensor factor. -/
    36	noncomputable def affineBaseChangeIso :
    37	    pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))
    38	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))) ≅
    39	      Spec (.of (K ⊗[R] A)) :=
    40	  pullbackSymmetry _ _ ≪≫ pullbackSpecIso R K A
    41	
    42	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
    43	theorem affineBaseChangeIso_inv_fst :
    44	    (affineBaseChangeIso R K A).inv ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =
    45	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    46	        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
    47	          A →ₐ[R] K ⊗[R] A).toRingHom) := by
    48	  simp [affineBaseChangeIso]
    49	
    50	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
    51	theorem affineBaseChangeIso_inv_snd :
    52	    (affineBaseChangeIso R K A).inv ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
    53	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    54	        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom :
    55	          K →+* K ⊗[R] A)) := by
    56	  simp [affineBaseChangeIso]
    57	
    58	/-- Base change of an affine morphism over Spec R. -/
    59	noncomputable def affineBaseChangeMap (phi : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    60	    pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)))
    61	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))) ⟶
    62	      pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))
    63	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))) :=
    64	  pullback.map _ _ _ _
    65	    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi.toRingHom)) (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
    66	    (by
    67	      rw [Category.comp_id, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    68	      congr 2
    69	      exact phi.comp_algebraMap.symm)
    70	    (by simp)
    71	
    72	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
    73	theorem affineBaseChangeMap_fst (phi : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    74	    affineBaseChangeMap R K A B phi ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =

    80	theorem affineBaseChangeMap_snd (phi : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    81	    affineBaseChangeMap R K A B phi ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
    82	      pullback.snd _ _ := by
    83	  unfold affineBaseChangeMap
    84	  rw [pullback.lift_snd]

    89	/-- The affine base-change isomorphisms intertwine a base-changed morphism with
    90	the Spec of its scalar extension. -/
    91	theorem affineBaseChangeIso_naturality (phi : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    92	    affineBaseChangeMap R K A B phi ≫ (affineBaseChangeIso R K A).hom =
    93	      (affineBaseChangeIso R K B).hom ≫
    94	        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    95	          (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
    96	            (R := R) (K := K) phi).toRingHom) := by

    99	  rw [← cancel_mono (affineBaseChangeIso R K A).inv]

   105	    rw [affineBaseChangeIso_inv_fst (R := R) (K := K) (A := A)]
   106	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
   107	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
   108	    congr 2
   109	  · rw [Category.assoc, affineBaseChangeMap_snd]
   110	    simp only [Category.assoc]
   111	    rw [affineBaseChangeIso_inv_snd (R := R) (K := K) (A := B)]
   112	    rw [affineBaseChangeIso_inv_snd (R := R) (K := K) (A := A)]
   113	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
   114	    congr 2
   115	    ext x
   116	    simp [AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom]

    91	    (relation : forall j, Fin (m j) -> MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
